metric: Net operational risk losses, rolling 12 months
source_system: GRC tool (loss event database); general ledger
how_it_works_today: Loss events exported from the GRC tool each month and reconciled to the general ledger by hand
next_step: Automated feed from the GRC tool, with a monthly reconciliation check against the ledger

metric: Critical Operations recovered within tolerance in their last test
how_it_works_today: Noor compiles the last recovery result of each Critical Operation from test reports into a spreadsheet
next_step: Business continuity tool from 2027, once every tolerance, including the wallet's, is approved

metric: Severe ICT or cyber incidents affecting a Critical Operation, rolling 12 months
how_it_works_today: Incidents exported from the ticketing tool; severity and the Critical Operation affected are added by hand
next_step: Automated, once every incident ticket carries a Critical Operation field

metric: ICT and cyber control effectiveness index
source_system: Vulnerability scanner, identity platform, privileged access tool, SOC reports (SecureOps), CMDB
how_it_works_today: Index calculated in a workbook from ten Level 2 KRIs; four of the ten arrive by automated extract
next_step: Eight of ten inputs automated by Q4 2027; the index calculated in the GRC tool

metric: Critical providers without a tested exit plan
how_it_works_today: Exit-test status updated by hand in the outsourcing register by the third-party risk team
next_step: Third-party module of the GRC tool from Q3 2027

metric: Significant customer data breaches notified to the CBUAE, rolling 12 months
how_it_works_today: Compliance confirms each notified breach, with a second person checking
next_step: Stays manual by design: few events, each needs judgement. Four-eyes check kept

metric: Overdue high-rated audit and regulatory findings on ICT and resilience
how_it_works_today: Scheduled report from the findings tracker on working day 2
next_step: Done. The feed is monitored for freshness and completeness

metric: Critical Operations that depend on one person without a trained deputy
source_system: Dependency maps (RB-B3 workbook); HR succession register
how_it_works_today: Counted by hand from the dependency maps and the list of trained deputies
next_step: Semi-automated in Q4 2027, after the maps are reconciled with the CMDB

metric: Internal and external fraud losses, rolling 12 months
source_system: Fraud monitoring system; loss event database
how_it_works_today: Fraud losses exported from the fraud system and matched to loss events in a spreadsheet
next_step: Automated feed into the loss event database

metric: Board risk indicators with an owner, a source and a data contract
how_it_works_today: Owner, source and contract status kept in the KRI library workbook and counted each quarter
next_step: Kept in the GRC tool from 2027, with the count produced automatically
